label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Hi Renee, this is Thu, owner of Lotus Garden Nails. I am writing this myself. I am very upset, and when I am upset my English is worse, so please read this calmly. I am not writing to fight with you. You have been my customer for 2 years, and I am sorry your toe hurt. I really mean that.

I want to tell the facts, not attack you.

On Saturday Oct 24 you came for a deluxe pedicure, $45. My niece Vy did it. She is licensed 3 years. She was born in Houston. Her English is okay, she is just shy. I am sorry if she did not explain enough to you, but saying she barely speaks English is not fair to her.

About our tools: every tool comes from the autoclave in a sealed pouch, and we open the pouch in front of the customer. Files and buffers are new for each person, and the customer takes them home. The tub gets a new plastic liner every time. We passed the state inspection in August 2026 with no violations, and the paper is on the wall. I have been in Houston 19 years and opened in 2007 after working for my aunt. In all that time we never had one infection complaint. I cannot know everything about your toe, but I can tell you our cleaning is not dirty.

During the pedicure, you told Vy to cut the cuticle more, more, you wanted it clean. Vy told you not too much. You said it was fine, you always do. I am not saying this to blame you. I am saying Vy was trying to be careful.

When you came back on Nov 2 and showed me your red toe, I offered you the full $45 back and to pay your urgent care copay if you bring the receipt. That offer is still open. You asked for $300 cash and a free pedicure for one year. I said no to that. I did not mean to make you feel I shrugged at you. If I did, I am sorry.

Please call the salon phone and ask for Thu, or come in and talk to me. I will sit down with you. I do not want this to be a fight on the forum. You are still welcome to talk to me.

Marisol, thank you for speaking up and being fair. I appreciate it.

To the neighbors: I understand infection sounds scary. But when someone says all these places are dirty, like we are all the same, it hurts me most. My niece read the comments and cried all night. She wants to quit doing nails. This is our livelihood. Please judge us by our inspection and our work, not by one post.
